description: Ask another AI model (GPT, Gemini, Grok and others) one question through keyfo and get its answer, for a second opinion. This is a paid model call: it needs a key and draws from the key’s daily allowance at the model’s price. A trial key can ask low-cost models only. The other model gets no tools.

max_tokens.description: Longest answer in tokens, from 1 to 2048. 512 by default; a trial key gets 512 at most.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

model.description: Model ID with its vendor, like x-ai/grok-4.3 or google/gemini-2.5-flash. Empty uses a low-cost default model.
model.title: Model

prompt.description: The question for the other model, with all the context it needs: it does not see this conversation.
prompt.title: Prompt

system.description: Optional instructions for the other model.
system.title: System

name: ask_model
title: Ask another model
